name: Hiroi Hisoka
source:
Hobbies: Music, playing the guitar
Likes: Taiyaki, pocky
Dislikes: Studying

The guitarist of the light music club who is quite carefree. Her dream is to be a musician in the future, and she is in the band together with [url=/c55538]Kanna[/url]. She holds the popular but banned "virtual lives" while using a disguise so she won't get caught. Hisoka is often worried that due to her very poor grades she'll get kicked out from school, but [url=/c54699]Seita[/url] offers to help her by giving her test answers...
